summary: OpenCode made Tencent's Hy4 flash free on 2026-11-16, announcing near-unlimited usage for the next 2 weeks. Hy4 flash is Hy's fastest and most cost-efficient model, with a 1M-token context window and image input. OpenCode's Console docs list Hy4 flash Free (hy4-flash-free) with free input, output and cached reads for a limited time, and its provider follows a zero-retention policy. No exact end date is published: the 2026-11-30 expiry is derived from "the next 2 weeks" in the announcement and is approximate. The free tier works only inside the OpenCode app. The Inference API docs say other clients receive HTTP 403, even with an API key, and a keyless direct call on 2026-11-16 was rejected (HTTP 429, "Free models work in OpenCode"). No in-app request was tested.
claim_steps: Install the OpenCode app from https://opencode.ai.
Run /models and select Hy4 flash Free (opencode/hy4-flash-free).
Use it from inside OpenCode only. Per OpenCode's Inference API docs, other clients receive HTTP 403 for free-tier models, even with an API key.
The free period is about 2 weeks from 2026-11-16 ("for the next 2 weeks"); OpenCode has not published an exact end date.
